notes: Encoded ONLY from H. B. Smith's own page. No successor asserted beyond the page's own parent statement. COUNTING: page Style 2 states year is in the '7th & 8th digits (includes dashes)', establishing character-inclusive counting on this page; that convention is applied to Style 3 as well (see its notes).
parent: Smith Cast Iron Boilers, Westcraft, Inc., a Mestek Technology, Inc., company

styles.notes: Month = 1st & 2nd numerical digits -> [0,2] -> '05'; year = 3rd & 4th numerical digits -> [2,4] -> '99' -> 1999. All-digit serial, no counting ambiguity.

styles.era: 9-character normalized serials, digit + letter + 7 digits (raw form with dashes), year only
styles.notes: Year is coded in the raw form's 7th & 8th characters counting dashes ('8-W-3-053714': chars 7,8 = '0','5'); after normalization strips the dashes those are normalized positions [3,5] -> '05' -> 2005. The page's parenthetical '(includes dashes)' is what selects this reading over digit-only counting (7th & 8th digits -> '1','4' -> 2014), which is NOT shipped. No month is stated for this style, so year-only.

styles.era: 8-character normalized serials, letter + 6 digits + letter, year only
styles.notes: Month = 1st letter digit 'D', chart-only, so year-only. Year = 2nd & 3rd characters -> [1,3] -> '86' -> 1986, giving the clean month-letter + year structure D|86; this follows the page's character-inclusive counting established by Style 2's '(includes dashes)'. The digit-only alternative (2nd & 3rd numerical digits '6','2' -> 1962) is documented here but NOT shipped.
